description: 日本を初めて訪れた海外からの旅行者が、たくさん並んだカプセルトイの機械に興味を持ち、夢中になってガチャガチャを回している場面。

stage1.passage: Some visitors enjoy trying capsule toy machines when they travel in Japan. These machines offer many kinds of small toys, and the surprise of not knowing which item will come out makes the experience exciting.

q1.text: Why do some visitors find capsule toy machines exciting?
modelAnswers: Because they do not know which toy will come out of the machine.
They find them exciting because the surprise of getting an unknown item makes the experience fun.

questions.text: Have you ever tried a capsule toy machine? What did you get?
modelAnswers: Yes, I have. I got a small character figure from a capsule toy machine.
I sometimes play capsule toy machines when I see something cute.
No, I have never tried one, but I would like to get a Japanese character toy.

questions.text: What Japanese things or experiences do you think are interesting for visitors from other countries?
modelAnswers: I think Japanese food and traditional festivals are interesting for visitors from other countries.
Anime, capsule toys, and Japanese technology may be interesting because they are different from things in other countries.
I think visitors should experience both traditional places such as temples and modern Japanese culture.

sentences.text: An overseas visitor is enthusiastically trying a capsule toy machine during his first trip to Japan.
sentences.grammar: 現在進行形・duringを用いた前置詞句
sentences.ja: 海外からの旅行者が初めての日本旅行中に、楽しそうにカプセルトイの機械を試しています。

sentences.text: He is surrounded by rows of machines containing a wide variety of miniature toys and collectibles.
sentences.grammar: 受動態・現在分詞による後置修飾
sentences.ja: 彼の周囲には、さまざまなミニチュア玩具や収集品が入った機械が何列も並んでいます。

sentences.text: After inserting a coin, he is rotating the handle while eagerly waiting to see which toy he will receive.
sentences.grammar: After＋動名詞・現在進行形・while節・間接疑問文which
sentences.ja: 硬貨を入れた後、彼はどのおもちゃが出てくるのか楽しみに待ちながらハンドルを回しています。

sentences.text: His expression suggests that he is fascinated by both the variety of the machines and the surprise of not knowing what he will get.
sentences.grammar: suggest that節・both A and B・動名詞・間接疑問を含むwhat節
sentences.ja: 彼の表情から、機械の種類の豊富さと、何が出るかわからない驚きの両方に魅了されていることがうかがえます。

sentences.text: Since this is his first visit to Japan, the capsule toy area may feel especially novel and distinctive to him.
sentences.grammar: Sinceを用いた理由節・助動詞may・feel＋形容詞
sentences.ja: 彼にとって初めての日本訪問なので、カプセルトイ売り場は特に目新しく独特に感じられるのかもしれません。

sentences.text: The scene illustrates how an ordinary form of entertainment can become a memorable cultural experience for an international visitor.
sentences.grammar: 間接疑問を含むhow節・助動詞can・become＋補語
sentences.ja: この場面は、日常的な娯楽が海外からの旅行者にとって思い出深い文化体験になり得ることを示しています。

sentences.text: Although each capsule toy is inexpensive, visitors may spend more than they expect because they want to try several different machines.
sentences.grammar: Althoughを用いた譲歩節・比較表現more than・because節
sentences.ja: 一つ一つのカプセルトイは安価ですが、さまざまな機械を試したくなり、旅行者は予想以上にお金を使うことがあるかもしれません。

sentences.text: Experiences like this can help visitors discover aspects of modern Japanese culture that they might not have planned to explore.
sentences.grammar: 動名詞主語・help O do・関係代名詞that・might＋現在完了形
sentences.ja: このような体験は、旅行者がもともと予定していなかった現代日本文化の一面を発見するきっかけになり得ます。
